scope: Local saved artifacts only; no model execution, environment operation or remote action.
baseline_limitation: Current learned baselines contain seed 42 only and are reused across all three candidate seeds.
monthly_deficit_definition: (candidate_month_loss - GRU_month_loss) * month_samples / all_samples; share divides by the overall population-weighted loss difference. Negative monthly shares are improvements; signed shares may exceed 100 percent.
curves_limitation: Logged training losses are recent stochastic training windows, not matched full-population evaluation; they must not be treated as directly comparable train-validation generalization gaps.
legacy_selection_limitation: Legacy curve minima below concern the alpha aggregate metric. V1/V2 checkpoint selection used version-specific direction objectives; these minima need not be the selected checkpoints.

history.duplicate_note: Wrong-preset repeat of the earlier a-direction64 seed 42; not an independent replication.

follow_up_20261017.scope: Verified local saved artifacts and mathematical counterexamples only; no new model execution, export, environment operation, synchronization or training.

fixed_full_train_prior.source: full cleaned train population, not the annual-recency-weighted sampler population
fixed_full_train_prior.calculation: For each market/horizon, pi=train_count/sum(train_counts); CE=sum(test_count_k * -log(pi_k))/N; Brier=sum(test_count_k * (sum(pi_j^2)+1-2*pi_k))/N; average the fourteen horizons equally.

mathematical_checks.inferences: Bounded Huber gradients do not imply a positive loss floor. MSE group means are not Huber-optimal constants. Per-sample normalization after p*pi/mean(p) need not yield mean(p_new)=pi. Zero neutral argmax predictions do not alone prove probability miscalibration.
